flights.label: One-way tickets
flights.text: Book every flight as its own one-way ticket. That is the only way the 2-for-1 applies, so a trip with three flights is three bookings, each with the companion added.

flights.label: From Houston
flights.text: Southwest flies to Hawaii from Hobby only, and every itinerary connects. The connecting city shows at booking.

flights.label: Through Vegas or Seattle
flights.text: Las Vegas is nonstop on every leg: Houston to Vegas, then Vegas to Honolulu, Kahului, Kona, Lihue or Hilo. Seattle is nonstop from Houston on weekdays only, and Southwest's Seattle flights to Hawaii connect. A night in either city still lands you in Honolulu on Dec 19, and the trip stays at 10 days or fewer.

flights.label: Between islands
flights.text: Honolulu connects to every island. The nonstops that skip Honolulu are Kona to Kahului and Kahului to Lihue, once a day each.

flights.label: Two for one
flights.text: The 2-for-1 works like Southwest's Companion Pass: one companion flies for taxes and fees, from $5.60 each way, as often as you fly, on paid or points tickets.

flights.label: Bags
flights.text: From Houston, $45 for the first bag and $55 for the second, per person. Between islands, $30 and $40 for visitors. A Southwest credit card makes the first bag free.

boat.label: Maui to Lānaʻi
boat.text: Expeditions sails from Maalaea to Manele three times a day, about 70 minutes each way, $66 a person each way.

boat.label: Holidays
boat.text: The ferry doesn't post a Christmas or New Year's Day schedule.

lahaina: Front Street (Papalaua to Shaw) reopened to vehicles on Aug 1, 2026. Open: five north-end Front Street restaurants (Honu, Star Noodle, Mala, Coco Deck, Aloha Mixed Plate), Lahaina Cannery Mall shops, the Banyan Tree and Old Lahaina Luau. Still closed: Old Lahaina Courthouse, Baldwin Home, Market Street, Papelekane Street and Mokuhinia Place. Lahaina Small Boat Harbor has limited permitted commercial operations
